offer.label: What you are offering, in one line

do_not_contact.label: Do-not-contact list, one address per line

steps.title: Approve the site lookups
steps.gate_summary: Fetch up to {{inputs.max_pages}} pages from each kept prospect's own site ({{steps.load.outputs.kept}} sites, listed in {{run.dir}}/prospects.json).

steps.title: One checkable fact each
steps.prompt: Prospects are in {{run.dir}}/prospects.json and their fetched pages in {{run.dir}}/sources. Take every prospect whose position in the list, counted from 0, divided by 4 leaves {{index}}. For each, find one checkable fact on their own pages, quote it exactly and give its URL. No fact found: drop the prospect and say why. Write {{run.dir}}/hooks-{{index}}.json, and set the output key items to that path, one item per prospect (id, title, preview = the quote, url, status pending or dropped, reason).

steps.title: Write the first emails
steps.prompt:
Offer: {{inputs.offer}}

For every prospect kept in {{run.dir}}/hooks-*.json, write a subject and a first email under 100 words: the quoted fact in line one, one ask, no flattery opener. Write {{run.dir}}/emails.json as a list of {id, to, subject, body}.

steps.title: Check facts and rules
steps.prompt: Check every email in {{run.dir}}/emails.json against its hook and fetched page in {{run.dir}}/sources: the quote appears in the page, under 100 words, no unfilled template braces left, no flattery opener. Write {{run.dir}}/check.json with pass or the reason per email. Set flag to the id of the first email that failed, or none.

steps.title: Approve the drafts
steps.gate_summary: Save {{steps.write.outputs.count}} emails from {{run.dir}}/emails.json as Gmail drafts. Nothing is sent. Check result: {{steps.check.outputs.passed}}, flag: {{steps.check.outputs.flag}}.
